xAxis.description: X-axis value of the data point if the point is not missing.

yAxis.description: Y-axis value of the data point if the point is not missing.

xAxisRaw.description: X-axis value of the data point.

yAxisRaw.description: Y-axis value of the data point.

xAxisMissing.description: True if the x-axis value is missing

yAxisMissing.description: True if the y-axis value is missing

size.description: The size of the data point.

category.description: The category of this data point that is used for coloring purposes.

display.description: Whether the data point should be displayed.

missingAvg.description: The average of the xAxis and yAxis missing metric values.

highRisk.description: Whether the displayed data point is high risk or not.

xAxisName.description: Selected {@link Sensor#name} at x-axis variable to display in the {@link UiSdlScatterPlotDataSpec#tooltipAdditionalFields}

yAxisName.description: Selected {@link Sensor#name} at y-axis variable to display in the {@link UiSdlScatterPlotDataSpec#tooltipAdditionalFields}

xAxisDescription.description: Selected {@link Sensor#description} at x-axis variable to display in the {@link UiSdlScatterPlotDataSpec#tooltipAdditionalFields}

yAxisDescription.description: Selected {@link Sensor#description} at y-axis variable to display in the {@link UiSdlScatterPlotDataSpec#tooltipAdditionalFields}

timestamp.description: The specific timestamp at which each data point was computed.
